android.releaseNotes:
• True WhatsApp Tick Semantics: Fixed premature double gray tick on sent messages by strictly adhering to Clock (sending) -> Single Gray Tick (sent to server) -> Double Gray Tick (delivered) -> Double Blue Tick (read receipt).
• Message Status Persistence: Resolved issue where sent messages showed double ticks when sent but reverted to single tick upon app reload or restart.
• E2EE Plaintext Preservation & Push Delivery: Guarantees sender plaintext preservation against server ciphertext echo and high-priority background notification delivery.
